净值已扣双边交易成本 10.0 bp（换手率 × 费率）；多空/十分层均含停牌股剔除（收益为 NaN 不参与）。
设计意图： Keeps drawdown volatility-adjusted stress as primary payoff mechanism (strong payoff evidence). Adds a lightweight bounded weight (0.8-1.2) based on 126-day return skewness to modulate the signal: negative skew (downside tail) amplifies drawdown signal, positive skew attenuates it. This addresses the parent's low rank IC by incorporating return asymmetry regime information from secondary parent.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(ts_sum(divide(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 20)), 1), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20)), 5), subtract(1, multiply(0.2, tanh(fillna(ts_skew(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 126), )))))
  2. 2. ts_sum —— 过去 N 天滚动求和
    ts_sum(divide(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 20)), 1), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20)), 5)
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 20)), 1), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20))
  4. 4. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 20)), 1)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjClose, 20))
  6. 6. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjClose, 20)
  7. 7. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20)
  8. 8. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(1, multiply(0.2, tanh(fillna(ts_skew(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 126), ))))
  9. 9. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(0.2, tanh(fillna(ts_skew(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 126), )))
  10. 10. tanh —— 双曲正切
    tanh(fillna(ts_skew(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 126), ))
  11. 11. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(ts_skew(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 126), )
  12. 12. ts_skew —— 滚动偏度
    ts_skew(ts_pct(AdjClose, 1), 126)
  13. 13. ts_pct —— 过去 N 天变化率
    ts_pct(AdjClose, 1)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
tanh计算双曲正切值
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)
ts_pctd 期变化率：(x − x_shift(d)) / x_shift(d)
ts_skewn 期移动偏度（分布不对称度）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 rolling_max：close.滚动窗口(20, min_periods=20).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：(close / rolling_max) - 1.0
  3. 计算 high：high.values.astype(np.float64)
  4. 计算 low：low.values.astype(np.float64)
  5. 计算 close：close.values.astype(np.float64)
  6. 计算 atr：pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index)
  7. 计算 atr：atr
  8. 计算 normalized_dd：drawdown / atr
  9. 计算 stress：normalized_dd.滚动窗口(5, min_periods=5).sum()
  10. 计算 skew：returns.滚动窗口(126, min_periods=126).skew()
  11. 计算 weight：1.0 - 0.2 * np.tanh(skew)
  12. 计算 factor：stress * weight
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_skew_adjusted_stress(df): df_copy = df.copy() rolling_max = df_copy["str">'close'].rolling(20, min_periods=20).max() drawdown = (df_copy["str">'close'] / rolling_max) - 1.0 high = df_copy["str">'high'].values.astype(np.float64) low = df_copy["str">'low'].values.astype(np.float64) close = df_copy["str">'close'].values.astype(np.float64) atr = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20), index=df_copy.index) atr = atr.replace(0.0, np.nan) normalized_dd = drawdown / atr stress = normalized_dd.rolling(5, min_periods=5).sum() returns = df_copy["str">'close'].pct_change() skew = returns.rolling(126, min_periods=126).skew().fillna(0.0) weight = 1.0 - 0.2 * np.tanh(skew) factor = stress * weight df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_skew_adjusted_stress'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_skew_adjusted_stress']
